material_use.description: ISA-95 MaterialActual.MaterialUse — the ROLE of the material (actual). Mirrors the SegmentRequirement role.

qty_actual.description: Actual quantity of this material role (actual). Counterpart to SegmentRequirement.qty_planned.

equipment_ref.description: FK to Machine.machine_id (ACTUAL_EQUIPMENT; Machine ≡ Unit level) = EquipmentActual.EquipmentID. The equipment actually used.

status.description: Actual status of the stage (e.g. running, complete, aborted). Derived from the MES OrderState.

qty_rework.description: Parts sent to rework, counted at the machine for the running order. Reported by the machine source through objects[] (owner 25.09.); history: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/segment-response.md.
